brief:
India's opposition leader Rahul Gandhi has said New Delhi should maintain strong ties with Israel, Al Jazeera English reported. Gandhi's statement came despite the ongoing conflict in Gaza, where Israeli military operations have caused significant casualties and humanitarian concerns.

The Indian politician's remarks reflect the broader stance of India's political establishment on the country's relationship with Israel, even as the Gaza war has drawn international criticism and sparked debate in various nations over military support and diplomatic positions.
dek: India’s opposition leader Rahul Gandhi, says New Delhi should continue to maintain strong ties with Israel.
title: Rahul Gandhi backs India-Israel ties despite Gaza conflict
